$comment: Subset of the Control API that the in-repo MediaMTX GUI actually calls. Full parity still requires implementing all of openapi.yaml; this is the Phase 4 acceptance minimum.

controlApiRequired.responseShapeNotes: Expects JSON with items[] (or legacy paths[]). Each item needs name (or id).
2xx on success; error body text shown to user.

nonApiSurfacesUsedByGui.notes: CameraCell.vue POSTs SDP offer to this URL for playback.

corsNotes: GUI is often served from a different origin/port than the API (see gui/serve.mjs proxy). rmtx must honor apiAllowOrigins like MediaMTX.
